notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is one row of the tnlandforms Georgia index. No build date, design, staffing, status or access is documented in any source read. The name 'meda' is the index compiler's own label (names for towers 73 and above are its creation), so it may not be a historical name; no correction proposed without a historical source. The RoadsideThoughts page is a genealogy site used only to place the name in Putnam County; the story does not call Meda a community. Not in the cached NHLR Georgia index or the cached FFLOS Georgia index. Two web searches gave nothing tower-specific. Story is about 127 words; the evidence supports no more.
